question: Has Sager Food Products been acquired by or merged with another company? Who owns Sager Food Products now?
markdown:
Sager Food Products (Sager Foods) has not been acquired or merged; it remains an independent, family-owned business. It was founded in 1983 by Santo Fata Sr. in Montreal, Quebec, Canada, and is currently owned and operated by the Fata family, with Anthony Fata serving as President and family members active in management. [](https://ca.linkedin.com/in/anthony-fata-9907576)

_(Note: If you are thinking of the U.S. canned vegetable business **Sager Creek Vegetable Company**—formerly Allens, Inc.—that entity was acquired by Del Monte Foods in 2015 and later sold its brands to McCall Farms in 2017.)_ [](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/del-monte-foods-inc-purchases-sager-creek-to-expand-us-business-300048751.html)

-   **Founding:** Established in 1983 in Montreal.

-   **Core Focus:** Canada's leading packager and bottler of vegetable oils and private-label cooking oils.

-   **Leadership:** Headed by the Fata family (including as President and as Vice President). [](https://ca.linkedin.com/in/anthony-fata-9907576)

You can watch a [⁠Customer Story on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=63IW9TyoFr4) featuring operations at Sager Food Products. For background on related corporate names, [⁠Del Monte Foods on Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Del_Monte_Foods) outlines the separate Sager Creek history, and [⁠Del Monte Foods Purchases Sager Creek](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/del-monte-foods-inc-purchases-sager-creek-to-expand-us-business-300048751.html) provides details on that distinct transaction. Additionally, [⁠Valeo Foods Group](https://www.valeofoodsgroup.com/content/news/2026/valeo-foods-group-accelerates-growth-in-eastern-eu) tracks concurrent European food industry developments. [](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/del-monte-foods-inc-purchases-sager-creek-to-expand-us-business-300048751.html)

Are you looking for information on the **Canadian vegetable oil supplier** (Sager Foods) or did you mean the **U.S. canned vegetable brand** (Sager Creek / Allens)? Let me know if you need product details for either.
